name: phpMyAdmin
about: phpMyAdmin is a free, open-source administration tool for MySQL and MariaDB. It provides broad functionality via a web interface for creating and managing databases, tables, users, and SQL queries.
useCases: Essential for developers and DBAs managing MySQL/MariaDB databases who need a visual interface for administration.

whyDeploy.title: Database At Your Fingertips
whyDeploy.description: Manage your databases visually from any browser, running on just 2GB RAM.
